*   `clip_z`: Float representing clip-space depth [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly defines `fog_dist` as `gl_FragCoord.z / gl_FragCoord.w`. In OpenGL, `gl_FragCoord.z` represents the clip-space depth (after perspective division by the vertex shader's projection matrix, but before the final NDC conversion in the fixed function pipeline, it is the z-component of the clip-space coordinates). The claim states that `clip_z` is a float representing clip-space depth. Since the evidence uses `gl_FragCoord.z` to calculate fog distance based on depth, and `gl_FragCoord.z` is the standard variable for clip-space depth in the fragment shader context (specifically, it holds the z-coordinate of the clip-space position), the fact that the code relies on this value for depth-based calculations supports the claim that the variable represents clip-space depth.
